newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI NEAR RECORDS AS NOKIA TESTS RESISTANCE.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI NEAR RECORDS AS NOKIA TESTS RESISTANCE.

text.p: Shares were up near all time
records in early Friday trade as Nokia resumed a test on
resistance at 340 markka and Incap and Sampo firm, brokers said.
As the session developed Nokia retreated to 337.50, up 0.50.
"It is possible for Nokia to break 340 today, depending on
its ADR," one broker said. If that happened, Nokia would be back
up at the level it peaked at in 1995, before a sudden profit
warning led international investors to flee the stock.
Another broker saw Nokia's ADR on Wall St headed for a test
on $70 in the next fortnight -- which would take its Helsinki
stock 350 to 360 markka if the Fed did not hike rates.
